# `census_geocoder_geographies`

**Census returned geography candidates**

One native returned geography per lookup candidate and layer, with exact identifiers and source locators.

**Coverage.** Sampled. Explicit single-record Census2020 address and coordinate lookups only. Local qualification covers the retained cohort; public delivery is separate. No national completeness, current district, ACS estimate, batch or ZIP-centroid claim. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `census_geocoder_geographies.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lookup_id` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 identity of the complete official request URL, including original input and fixed source versions. |
| `kind` | `VARCHAR` | Official single-record onelineaddress or coordinates search type. |
| `benchmark` | `VARCHAR` | Exact selected address locator benchmark, Public_AR_Census2020. |
| `vintage` | `VARCHAR` | Exact selected geography vintage, Census2020_Census2020; not acquisition time or an ACS estimate vintage. |
| `outcome` | `VARCHAR` | Matched, unmatched, ambiguous, refused or conversion_failed; only matched establishes a unique returned candidate. |
| `reason` | `VARCHAR` | Explicit source interpretation or refusal reason, otherwise null. |
| `request_url` | `VARCHAR` | Exact official GET request with original address or decimal coordinate strings and selected versions. |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | UTC time when the complete response was captured. |
| `response_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | Digest of the complete retained original response bytes. |
| `source_release_logical_id` | `VARCHAR` | Logical identity of the admitted SpicyDocs lookup release. |
| `source_release_digest` | `VARCHAR` | Exact artifact digest of the admitted SpicyDocs lookup release. |
| `candidate_index` | `INTEGER` | Zero-based candidate index; every ambiguous candidate remains separate. |
| `unique_assignment` | `BOOLEAN` | True only when the lookup has one supported matched candidate. Filter this before using an assignment. |
| `matched_address` | `VARCHAR` | Literal matchedAddress; null for coordinate lookup. |
| `x` | `VARCHAR` | Exact native longitude decimal spelling for an address candidate, or original coordinate input string, in degrees. |
| `y` | `VARCHAR` | Exact native latitude decimal spelling for an address candidate, or original coordinate input string, in degrees. |
| `layer` | `VARCHAR` | Literal publisher geography layer label; layer vintages do not establish current district boundaries. |
| `geoid` | `VARCHAR` | Literal publisher GEOID, preserving leading zeros. |
| `name` | `VARCHAR` | Literal publisher NAME, if present; null stays distinct from an empty string. |
| `state_code` | `VARCHAR` | Literal two-digit STATE code when present. |
| `county_code` | `VARCHAR` | Literal three-digit COUNTY code when present. |
| `county_geoid` | `VARCHAR` | STATE plus COUNTY where both are present, using the pinned RefSpec composition; no county inference for other layers. |
| `tract_code` | `VARCHAR` | Literal six-digit TRACT code when present. |
| `block_code` | `VARCHAR` | Literal four-digit BLOCK code when present. |
| `json_pointer` | `VARCHAR` | Exact geography record locator in the retained complete response. |
| `geography_json` | `VARCHAR` | Complete native geography object; derived JSON uses exact decimal strings for decimal numbers. Original numeric tokens remain in response_json. |
| `geography_authority` | `VARCHAR` | Pinned RefSpec Census identifier guidance defining county GEOID composition; not a geographic entity roster. |
| `geography_source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | Digest of the original Census identifier guidance retained by RefSpec. |
